sentences.en: I want to make sure I'm not overestimating my abilities.
sentences.zh: 我想要确保我没有高估自己的能力。

sentences.en: One cannot overestimate the importance of getting up early.
sentences.zh: 不能低估早起的重要性。

sentences.en: I sometimes think that God in creating man somewhat overestimated his ability.
sentences.zh: 有时我认为上帝在创造人类时可能有些高估了人的能力。

senses.zh: 对……评价过高；对……估计过高
估计过高；评价过高；出价过高
